thread:
ashley: Heads-up — console shows a weird spike in SSE reconnect counts for EU routes starting ~08:40 UTC. Session count doubled for a small cohort, not across all tenants. Anyone seeing duplicate resume charges?

devon: Seeing it too. Logs mark many of those as 'client-backoff' but billing events still have resume=true. My hunch: proxy does a quick route flip (keepalive->fallback) and the billing extractor treats the resumed stream as a fresh resume.

ben: I can reproduce locally with a simulated keepalive timeout + immediate reconnect. Console graphs show duplicate_conn events clustered around route-change windows. Suspect routing policy fallback triggers re-handshake.

michelle: @devon can you paste a representative log snippet? need the sequence around the reconnect.

devon: Sure — sample from edge logs:
```
2024-03-28T08:39:12.123Z INFO proxy route=eu-west req_id=abc123 session_id=sess-77 event=keepalive_miss
2024-03-28T08:39:12.128Z INFO proxy route=eu-east req_id=abc123 session_id=sess-77 event=route_swap -> route=eu-east
2024-03-28T08:39:12.130Z INFO client reconnect_sent req_id=abc123 session_id=sess-78 resume=true
2024-03-28T08:39:12.132Z INFO billing emit resume_charge tenant=42 req_id=abc123 session_id=sess-78
```
Note session_id changed after the swap but we still billed a resume.

sre-bot: [alert] streaming_reconnects.alert triggered: streaming_reconnects>threshold (2.1k in 10m)

ashley: Telemetry question: do we currently surface a reconnect_reason dimension (heartbeat-miss, proxy-reset, auth-rotate, client-backoff) end-to-end in the Console? We need to triage quickly.

console-team: We capture reconnect_reason at the proxy ingest stage but the field is trimmed before the Console pipeline to save cardinality. We can add a high-cardinality tag behind a feature flag but it needs schematization.

ben: Short-term mitigation idea: add a billing-worker-level dedupe that ignores resume charges when reconnect_reason is in ["client-backoff","keepalive-probe","probe-loop"] and there's a route_swap within 250ms of reconnect. This should avoid double-billing while we fix routing.

michelle: I like that. But we must rollout carefully. Proposal: implement dedupe behind a canary flag 'reconnect_dedupe_canary' and only enable for a small tenant set. Also add an audit counter so we can measure how many suppressed charges would have been applied.

devon: To help debugging, proxy team can emit a compact lifecycle event 'reconnect_phase' with values: pre_swap, post_swap, reconnect_sent, billing_emitted. That will let us draw the timing diagram in Console.

ashley: Example rollout fragment for rollout-service config (pseudo):
```json
{
  "flag": "reconnect_dedupe_canary",
  "tenants": [42, 99, 314],
  "stages": {"staging": true, "prod_canary": true}
}
```
This will gate both billing dedupe and extra telemetry.

ben: Another subtlety: our Console UI links rely on session_id to dedupe graphs. If the session_id is regenerated on route flip we lose continuity. Candidate fix: persist an opaque session_handle that survives route swaps and use that as UI grouping.

michelle: I'll prototype session_handle glue and run a small A/B where the handle is emitted from proxy before route swap. If stable, we can switch the UI to session_handle for continuity.

ashley: Timeline suggestion: patch billing dedupe + telemetry schema today (EOD), push to staging; enable canary for 3 tenants; observe for 48h; if metrics good, expand canary. Console UI panel to display 'suppressed_resume_charges' next week.

devon: I'll open a PR for the telemetry schema change and add unit tests for the new event. Also will add an integration test: simulate keepalive->fallback loop and assert billing events == 1 for canary tenants.

ben: I'll implement the billing-worker dedupe and add an internal metric 'billing_dedupe.count' and 'billing_dedupe.potentially_suppressed' so we can validate correctness.

michelle: I'll own the Console panel. Will add a small grafana panel first, then convert to Console dashboard.

ashley: :thumbsup: please ping here with PR links and the staging link. If we see any regressions, roll back the flag immediately.

devon: PR: https://git.redwood/edge/PR/4567 (wip) — adding reconnect_phase + session_handle. Will update after tests.

sre-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging edge at 2024-04-02T03:00Z, billing-worker patch to follow.

ben: Thanks everyone, will coordinate rollout schedule with infra.

ashley: Follow-ups: (1) confirm telemetry retention/ingest cost for the new tag, (2) add synthetic test as @devon suggested, (3) health-check alarms for billing_dedupe.count spike.

michelle: On it. I’ll create tickets and link them here.

ben: Leaving a note — if we see any tenant-reported double charges we should open a fast-track support flow to credit them while we debug.

ashley: Agreed. We'll prepare the support playbook and a short message template.

michelle: created tickets: RINF-4212 (billing dedupe), RINF-4213 (telemetry schema), RINF-4214 (console panel). Links in the PRs.

devon: Will follow up with a timeline in the PR.

ashley: Thanks — marking this thread resolved for now, will reopen if staging shows issues.
